verified_fixes.observations: End-to-end flow walked under a synthetic Mongo session (Bearer token persisted via localStorage key 'aurin_session_token' + session_token cookie): cabinet-intro visible → cabinet-intro-begin clicked → cabinet-confirm visible → 3 checkboxes checked (cabinet-confirm-a/b/c) → cabinet-confirm-continue enabled (is_disabled()==False) → clicked → cabinet-chat visible → cabinet-input filled and cabinet-send clicked → cabinet-bubble-guide rendered (guide reply arrived from /api/cabinet/message) → cabinet-reset clicked ONCE (window.confirm removed as described) → cabinet-intro reappeared with count=1; cabinet-chat count=0; cabinet-confirm count=0. handleReset in PrivateRoom.jsx now awaits clearCabinet() and unconditionally resets local state (messages=[], showContinuation=false, threadKey=null, keepThread=false, confirms={a/b/c:false}, input='', error=null) before setPhase(PHASES.INTRO).

pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11.py → 16 passed in 4.94s. Covers cabinet auth gating (4x 401), cabinet flow (me/start/message crisis+thread+empty-400/continuation-after-3/clear), books regression (7 books incl. beyond-the-matrix-i + static PDF 200), and untouched-endpoint smoke (blog list, content brand, experience me 401).

critical_code_review_comments: LibraryKidsRead.jsx: the independent-promise pattern (two .then/.catch with a Promise.all join) is clean and resilient to one-sided 422s — good fix.

PrivateRoom.jsx handleReset: great that the 'even if backend errors, return the user to a clean local state' comment matches the implementation (try/catch is empty and state reset runs unconditionally). Single-click UX without window.confirm is also a better fit for a 'quiet room' interaction.

Minor (not blocking): PrivateRoom.jsx still holds all sub-panels and ~500 lines in one file; splitting SoftGate / IntroLetter / ConfirmPanel / ChatPanel / Bubble into /components/cabinet/* would help future edits and testability, but is cosmetic.

Minor: LibraryKidsRead.jsx filter `books.filter((b) => !!b.pdf_url)` would also surface a paid-kids book that merely has a sample PDF — currently only angels-tales qualifies so no regression, but if a priced kids book ships later with a pdf_url it will appear in the 'Free to read' column. Consider tightening to `!b.price || b.price === 0` if that ever becomes a concern.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration-11 P0 bugs are fully resolved. Backend: keep using /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11.py as the regression suite (16/16). Frontend auth-for-tests: Bearer token MUST be stored in localStorage under key 'aurin_session_token' BEFORE navigating to any auth-gated page (cookie alone is not enough — AuthProvider reads localStorage via lib/api.js interceptor). See the working pattern in this iteration: go to origin → page.evaluate localStorage.setItem → context.add_cookies → navigate. LemonSqueezy checkout buttons remain intentionally placeholder (MOCKED) — do not flag. No further retest required for the two fixes.
rca of the issue: Both issues were frontend-only state-handling bugs. Issue 1: LibraryKidsRead.jsx was using a single awaited fetch chain and/or the wrong audience param on entries, so a 422 on /api/content/entries short-circuited the books fetch → kids-read-empty. Fix (verified): split fetchEntries and /api/books into independent promises, each with its own .catch; books filter keyed on !!pdf_url. Issue 2: handleReset posted /api/cabinet/clear but never called setPhase(PHASES.INTRO) — and it was additionally gated by window.confirm. Fix (verified): remove the confirm modal, unconditionally reset all local state + setPhase(PHASES.INTRO) inside a try/finally shape so even a backend error leaves the client on the intro letter.
